meta.title: LuneX Wallet — moonlight for the ledger
meta.description: LuneX is a demonstration web wallet. All data is fictional. No real financial operations, no custody.
meta.keywords: crypto wallet, LuneX, demo wallet, web wallet, portfolio

hero.lead: A wallet as a print shop: copper rules, bone type, lunar volume. No neon. Only the discipline of numbers.

gallery.title: Not a catalogue UI.
gallery.lead: LuneX is built as an object: concrete, oxidised copper, film. Still lifes of a workshop — not stock “crypto future”.

product.title: Six planes of the ledger.
product.lead: Each cell is a gesture. Mock data, open API contract.

portfolio.d: Sum, daily move, mix. Like a newspaper spread.

send.d: Form with a balance check. Demo — a gesture only.

history.d: In, out, swap. Three statuses, no garnish.

api.d: WalletApi. Your backend replaces mock in client.ts.

auth.d: Stub: any email opens the cabinet.

adaptive.d: Columns break honestly, no card soup.

method.title: Three beats, like an engraving.
method.s1d: Equity curve and allocation donut — immediately, no toy widgets.
method.s2d: Per-asset sparklines and volume bars. Swap the demo series for REST.
method.s3d: Send is theatre. Funds do not leave.

quote.text: “A figure should sound quiet, like copper on stone — otherwise it is advertising, not a ledger.”

faq.title: Three straight answers.
faq.a1: No. A UI prototype with no chain and no keys.
faq.q2: How do I attach a backend?
faq.a2: Implement WalletApi and swap it in lib/api/client.ts instead of mockApi.
faq.a3: No. Any credentials on sign-in are enough — it is a stub.

cta.title: The cabinet is open as a mock-up.
cta.lead: Sign in with any string. Charts are already inside.

disclaimer: LuneX Wallet is a demonstration project. All data is fictional and used only to visualize the interface. The service does not execute real financial operations and does not store user funds.

footer.blurb: A print shop for digital ledgers. Fictional data. No custody.

auth.title: Access
auth.lead: Stub. Any credentials open a demo session.
auth.error: Could not sign in. Try again.

cabinet.demoNote: Demo data. Not financial operations and not custody.

legal.privacyBody: The prototype collects no personal data, runs no analytics, stores no keys. Sign-in is a stub.
legal.termsBody: The interface exists only to demonstrate design. Balances and transactions are fictional.
